description: Retrieves a list of published styles (like colors, text attributes, effects, and layout grids) from a specified main Figma file (not a branch).

inputSchema.description: Request to retrieve styles from a Figma file.

file_key.description: Key of the main Figma file (not a branch) from which to retrieve published styles. Extract the file_key from the Figma URL: figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or figma.com/file/{file_key}/... Note: This endpoint only returns PUBLISHED styles from team libraries. For local/unpublished styles, use figma.get_file_json instead.
file_key.title: File Key
